items.briefing:
A growing concern for Australian workplaces is "Shadow AI" — staff using AI tools that haven't been approved or reviewed by their organisation. This creates real security risks, as sensitive information may be shared with unvetted platforms outside your organisation's control. Separately, a cheap phishing kit called NovaCookies is circulating online for just $320/month, allowing criminals to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts — a platform widely used across Australian businesses and training organisations.

If you use Microsoft 365, be cautious of unexpected login prompts or emails asking you to verify your account. **Always check with your IT team before using any new AI tool at work.**
